title: How Schools Can Teach Students About Honest Sources
description: A plain look at how teachers can help students judge where a claim comes from, with three classroom steps to try this week.
body:
Students meet claims all day, and most never ask where a claim came from. This post shows teachers three small steps that build the habit of asking, using examples from the week's news.

## Step one

Ask who wrote it.

## Step two

Ask what they gain.
